initialUserMessage: Continue the feature in docs/vibe-coding/27.08.2026-e0-contracts. The code is written and committed; what is left is phase 4. Read its spec.md, plan.md, status.md and handoff-notes.md — the last one is the outgoing session's own account of where the implementation diverged from the plan and what it left owed, so read it before you judge the diff. Then run every derived gate via gate-run, walk the Rn coverage, and open the PR when ship-lint passes. Do not re-plan and do not merge.
